name: קְצִיעָה
summary: Job names his second daughter Keziah. She and her sisters receive an inheritance alongside their brothers.

evidence.note: Keziah is named between Jemimah, the first daughter, and Keren-happuch, the third.
Job gives the three daughters an inheritance among their brothers.

note: Her name matches the spice noun whose plural occurs in Psalm 45:9. Job gives the order of the names without explaining their choice.
